work: JFS: Joint refinement + selection for segmentation
difference_from_our_spec: CLOSEST ANALOGUE. Same framing ('was the refinement worth it?') and a paired comparison with revert-on-failure, BUT it decides AFTER the refinement has run, so it saves ZERO compute, and its decision rule is not a learned regression. Our spec moves the identical question BEFORE the action and learns it; that relocation is the entire margin.

work: Russell & Wefald: Principles of metareasoning (value of computation)
difference_from_our_spec: FORMAL ANTECEDENT. Defines the value of a computation as expected benefit minus cost, decided before acting. Our spec is a concrete learned instantiation of this abstract principle inside a segmentation system; it contributes no new formal machinery.

work: Viola & Jones: Rapid object detection using a boosted cascade
difference_from_our_spec: MECHANISM PRECEDENT. Establishes execute/skip vetoing of an expensive stage. But the decision variable is a hand-designed detector response, not a learned paired quality gain, and there is no quality-preserving fallback to a higher-quality alternative output.

work: Latotzke et al.: Optimal pass-on criteria for cascaded classifiers
difference_from_our_spec: NEAREST MECHANISM. Derives optimal execute/skip criteria before an expensive stage with an explicit cost term. Differs in that the decision variable is a class-conditional likelihood ratio, not a regression on a paired continuous quality gain, and the task is classification, not dense segmentation with a preservable fallback output.

work: Kunzel et al.: Metalearners for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects (CATE)
paired_gain_target: YES (E[Y(1)-Y(0)|x] is the identical formal object)
difference_from_our_spec: IDENTICAL FORMAL TARGET, OUTSIDE IMAGING. Our paired refinement gain is formally a conditional average treatment effect on a deterministic paired contrast. Phase 23 already concluded the target formulation is standard causal-inference practice; our spec claims no novelty for the estimand and only instantiates it within segmentation routing.

work: Med-DANet: Dynamic architecture network for efficient medical segmentation
learned_gain: no (learned band selection, not a quality gain)
difference_from_our_spec: PRECEDENT FOR PER-SAMPLE COMPUTE DECISION IN MEDICAL SEGMENTATION. Selects an input resolution band before the forward pass. Differs: the decision variable is a learned architecture-selection score, not a predicted paired Dice gain, and there is no optional refinement acting on the output with a preservation fallback.

work: Med-DANet V2: dynamic architecture network v2
difference_from_our_spec: STRONGEST PRECEDENT FOR THE DECISION TIMING. Confirms that a pre-execution per-sample compute decision is established practice in medical segmentation. Differs in the decision variable (band score vs paired gain regression) and in the absence of a quality-preserving fallback output.

pre_execution: no (static per-image routing during the forward pass)
difference_from_our_spec: PRECEDENT FOR MULTI-DOMAIN ROUTING IN MEDICAL SEGMENTATION. Routes to experts. Differs: routing selects which parameters compute, not WHETHER an optional refinement runs, and there is no learned pre-execution prediction of output-quality gain and no fallback output.

work: Adaptive patching for efficient medical image segmentation
difference_from_our_spec: PRECEDENT FOR PRE-COMPUTATION COMPUTE ALLOCATION IN MEDICAL IMAGING. Allocates patches based on content. Differs: allocates WHERE to compute, not WHETHER to run a refinement, and carries no learned paired-gain target and no preservation fallback.

work: Mozannar & Sontag: Consistent estimators for learning to defer
paired_gain_target: no (0-1 loss, not a paired gain)
difference_from_our_spec: STRUCTURAL ANALOGUE WITH A DIFFERENT RESOURCE. Learns when to defer to a costly expert with an explicit cost. Differs: the deferred actor is a human expert, the objective is a classification loss rather than a paired segmentation Dice gain, and the fallback is the model's own prediction, not a preserved higher-quality output.

PRECEDENT FOR A REGION-PROPOSAL STAGE PRECEDING AN EXPENSIVE PER-REGION HEAD. Its proposals are GT-free. Differs: proposals select WHERE to run a detector, not WHETHER a refinement of an already-produced mask is worth running; no paired-gain target.

work: nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for medical image segmentation
difference_from_our_spec: BASELINE ARCHITECTURE AND ALWAYS-RUN COUNTEREXAMPLE. Its coarse-to-fine cascade always executes the fine stage, which is exactly the regime we propose to gate. Cited as the architectural ancestor of the regional-refinement stage, not as a competing method.
